patch.title: Nintendo Switch Sports
patch.tagline: Dunk, swing, kick, spike, and bowl your way to victory in eight motion-controlled sports.
patch.description_short: Play eight motion-controlled sports locally or online using Joy-Con controllers, including Basketball, Golf, Soccer, Volleyball, Bowling, Tennis, Badminton, and Chambara.
patch.description_ar: مجموعة رياضية حركية تضم ثماني رياضات: كرة السلة والغولف وكرة القدم والكرة الطائرة والبولينغ والتنس والريشة الطائرة وتشانبارا. تدعم اللعب المحلي والأونلاين باستخدام Joy-Con، ولا تدعم وضع Handheld لأن اللعب يتطلب وحدات تحكم منفصلة.
compatibility: Nintendo Switch 2: supported with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch
fitFor: Families and groups who want active motion-controlled party play
Players who want local matches for up to four people
Players who want online competition and rotating cosmetic rewards
notFitFor: Nintendo Switch Lite users without separate compatible Joy-Con controllers
Players looking for a traditional button-only sports simulation
patch.storySummary: This is a sports collection rather than a story campaign; players visit Spocco Square to compete in eight sports.

dlcList.name: No paid gameplay DLC
dlcList.description: Nintendo added Golf and Basketball through free software updates; no paid gameplay expansion is required for the eight listed sports.

updates.title: Golf update
updates.description: Nintendo added Golf as a free update.

updates.title: Basketball update
updates.description: Nintendo added Basketball as a free update.

patch.music: Nintendo has not published a standalone soundtrack product on the official store page; the game uses original menu and sport-specific music and effects.
patch.completionTime: No fixed completion time: matches are session-based and progression continues through online leagues and rotating rewards.
patch.completionistTime: No finite completionist time is published because online rewards and competitive progression rotate over time.
pros: Online play and free sport updates
cons: Some modes require extra Joy-Con accessories
Online features require Nintendo Switch Online
patch.verdictSummary: An accessible motion-sports collection that works best for local groups and online competition, with the important limitation that Handheld mode is not supported.

faq.a: Eight: Basketball, Golf, Soccer, Volleyball, Bowling, Tennis, Badminton, and Chambara.
No. Nintendo lists TV and Tabletop modes only.
Nintendo lists 1–4 players on one system and 1–2 players online; individual sports can have additional controller requirements.

faq.q: Does it work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo marks it supported with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch.

guides.title: Nintendo Switch Sports official site
guides.summary: Official sport, control, and update information.

patch.perfNotes: Nintendo confirms TV and Tabletop support but does not publish exact rendering resolution or frame-rate specifications.

devicePerformance.performanceNotes: Backward-compatible on Switch 2. Nintendo publishes no exact resolution or FPS; Handheld mode remains unsupported.

patch.title: Luigi’s Mansion 3
patch.tagline: The hotel is haunted. Mario is missing. And the only hope is Luigi.
patch.description_short: Explore the haunted Last Resort hotel, solve themed-floor puzzles, capture ghosts with the Poltergust G-00, and team up with Gooigi.
patch.description_ar: يستكشف لويجي فندق Last Resort المسكون لإنقاذ ماريو ورفاقه. استخدم Poltergust G-00 للإمساك بالأشباح، واستعن بـGooigi لحل الألغاز والوصول إلى الأماكن الضيقة، والعب القصة بتعاون محلي لشخصين أو أوضاع ScareScraper وScreamPark حتى ثمانية لاعبين.
compatibility: Nintendo Switch 2: supported with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch
fitFor: Players who enjoy environmental puzzles and exploration
Families wanting a spooky but lighthearted adventure
Players wanting story co-op or larger multiplayer modes
notFitFor: Players who only want fast combat without puzzles
Online players without Nintendo Switch Online
patch.storySummary: King Boo traps Mario, Peach, and the Toads inside paintings at the Last Resort hotel. Luigi climbs its themed floors with Professor E. Gadd, Polterpup, and Gooigi to rescue them.

dlcList.name: Luigi’s Mansion 3 Multiplayer Pack
dlcList.description: Paid multiplayer bundle containing Pack 1 and Pack 2 content for ScreamPark and ScareScraper, including costumes, themes, and minigames.

updates.title: Multiplayer Pack 1
updates.description: First paid multiplayer content pack released.

updates.title: Multiplayer Pack 2
updates.description: Second paid multiplayer content pack released.

patch.music: The haunted-hotel score changes with each themed floor; Nintendo does not list a standalone soundtrack on the eShop product page.
patch.completionTime: Nintendo does not publish an official story-hour estimate; completion varies with exploration, gems, Boos, and co-op play.
patch.completionistTime: Nintendo does not publish an official 100% time; collecting every gem and Boo and clearing multiplayer objectives adds substantial playtime.
cons: Some multiplayer content is paid DLC
Online multiplayer requires Nintendo Switch Online
patch.verdictSummary: A polished action-puzzle adventure with memorable themed floors, excellent animation, flexible Gooigi co-op, and separate multiplayer modes.

patch.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
patch.tagline: New characters and stages join the entire legacy roster.
patch.description_ar: لعبة القتال الكروس أوفر الأضخم من نينتندو، تجمع جميع المقاتلين السابقين مع شخصيات ومراحل جديدة، وأكثر من 900 مقطوعة موسيقية، وأطوار فردية ومحلية ولاسلكية وأونلاين. تدعم حتى 8 لاعبين على جهاز واحد، وحتى 8 محليًا لاسلكيًا، وحتى 4 عبر الإنترنت.
compatibility: Nintendo Switch 2: supported with behavior consistent with Nintendo Switch
fitFor: Local party groups and competitive fighting-game players
Nintendo fans who want a large crossover roster
Solo players interested in World of Light, Spirits, and Classic Mode
notFitFor: Players who do not enjoy platform-fighter knockback rules
Online players without Nintendo Switch Online
Players expecting all DLC fighters in the base purchase
patch.storySummary: In World of Light, the entity Galeem captures most fighters and turns characters into puppet combatants; Kirby begins a campaign to rescue the roster and confront the forces of light and darkness.

dlcList.name: Fighters Pass
dlcList.description: Five Challenger Packs with fighters, stages, music, and related content.

dlcList.name: Fighters Pass Vol. 2
dlcList.description: Six additional Challenger Packs with fighters, stages, music, and related content.

dlcList.name: Additional fighters and Mii Fighter costumes
dlcList.description: Nintendo also sells individual Challenger Packs, Piranha Plant, and optional Mii Fighter costumes.

updates.title: Version 13.0.1
updates.description: Final fighter-adjustment update listed by Nintendo support; later compatibility or maintenance changes may still occur.

patch.music: Nintendo advertises more than 900 music compositions spanning the represented game series.
patch.completionTime: No single official completion time: match-based modes are replayable, while World of Light length varies by route and difficulty.
patch.completionistTime: No finite official 100% time is published because Spirits, challenges, online play, and DLC substantially expand the scope.
pros: Exceptional roster, stage, and music breadth
Large amount of solo and multiplayer content
cons: Major extra fighters are paid DLC
Online play requires Nintendo Switch Online
The quantity of systems can overwhelm new players
patch.verdictSummary: A remarkably complete platform fighter with unmatched crossover breadth, strong local play, deep competitive mechanics, and extensive solo content.
